bpmn:process.studyflow:documentation: Element catalog: one live instance of every palette-visible element type, one labelled band per schema. Read top to bottom: the BPMN 2.0 base that Studyflow inherits (events, gateways, activities, data), then the studyflow core and the domain extensions that specialize it. Attribute values echo the paper's example study (consent form, completion code, eligibility criteria, N-back scene, BDM trials dataset). Pool/choreography types (cognitive:Actor, openbci:OpenBCISession, studyflow:ChoreographyTask) and the template presets (cognitive/datatrove/omniprocess/ml/agentic/openbci) are covered in kitchensink.cheatsheet.md.
bpmn:process.name: Studyflow element catalog (kitchen sink)

bpmn:textAnnotation.name: Text annotation
bpmn:textAnnotation.bpmn:text: A free-form note. Groups (these labelled bands) are artifacts too.

bpmn:categoryValue.value: studyflow · Core data elements (BDM, BIDS, Psych-DS, CSVW)
cognitive · Domain activities & research gateways (incl. Behaverse)
